spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Hedge is a clean, classic rectangular acoustic
divider designed to sit along the rear edge of desks in open-plan offices.
Featuring smooth rounded corners and clean finished edges without capping, Hedge
provides acoustic separation and physical definition between facing
workstations. Fixed non-destructively using Vicinity Clamps, it absorbs 1.00
to 1.10 Sabins per unit and delivers Group 1 fire compliance.
features: Classic linear rectangular screen profile with smooth rounded corners

Mounted non-destructively along desk rear edges with Vicinity Workstation
Clamps

High acoustic absorption rating of 1.00 (1600mm) to 1.10 (1800mm)
Sabins per unit

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum
of 80% recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and
AS 5637.1

Solid colour throughout with neat finished edges; no capping or
framing required

Pinnable self-healing surface for notes and workstation
personalisation

Clamps made from 100% recycled PET (RePET) or powdercoated
zinc
Moisture and mould resistant with an ASTM G21-15 Growth Rating of 0
Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified EPD

install:
Unpack Vicinity Hedge
screens and verify components

Insert Vicinity Desk Clamps into the routed
notches along the bottom edge of the screen

Position the screen squarely
along the back edge of the workstation

Tighten the clamp screws from
underneath the desk using an Allen key until firmly locked

Confirm the screen
is vertical, level, and securely positioned
selection_checklist:
Select
size based on desk width (Hedge 1600 for 1600mm desk; Hedge 1800 for 1800mm
desk)

Verify desk edge lip allows clamp clearance without fouling desk
frame
Choose colour from Autex Cube palette (20+ colours)

Confirm pack
quantity (supplied in packs of 4 screens)

Check that monitor arm mountings do
not conflict with screen clamp locations
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid wet
areas or direct liquid contact

Desktop must provide adequate rear edge
clearance for clamp mechanism
Sold in minimum pack quantities of 4 screens

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Hedge is a
classic linear acoustic workstation divider designed to mount along the rear
edge of 1600mm or 1800mm desks with smooth rounded corners. Crafted from 12mm
Cube polyester felt containing over 80% recycled PET, it absorbs direct speech
and keyboard noise (1.00 to 1.10 Sabins per unit) while doubling as a pinnable
noticeboard. Installed non-destructively via 100% recycled PET Vicinity Clamps
and rated Group 1 fire compliant, Hedge provides a clean, sustainable acoustic
boundary between facing desks.
